f89d305061.q: What is acuhypnosis and how does it combine hypnosis with acupuncture for fertility support?
f89d305061.a: Acuhypnosis is an integrative treatment that combines hypnosis with either acupuncture or acupressure. During an in-person acuhypnosis session, treatment begins with acupuncture while hypnosis guides the patient into a focused, relaxed state. During a virtual session, hypnosis is paired with guided acupressure techniques that patients can perform at home. The intention in both settings is to help slow down, settle into the present moment, and practice a different relationship with thoughts and feelings that may arise during the fertility journey.

f89d305061.rq: Hypnosis is relaxing the conscious mind so that the subconscious mind can receive positive suggestions and affirmations, and you remain a participant in the experience.

e2d1ea4148.q: How can hypnosis help manage stress and anxiety during fertility treatments and waiting periods?
e2d1ea4148.a: Fertility treatments often involve extensive waiting periods—waiting for your period, ovulation, OPK test results, follicle development, embryo development, and pregnancy test results. Hypnosis offers a unique opportunity to practice redirecting your attention during this waiting period through guided imagery and personalized suggestions, allowing you to recognize anxious thoughts without feeling you have to follow each one. While you may not be able to control the treatment outcome, you can gradually build skills for caring for yourself while waiting.

2f4dadbcb9.q: What is a relaxation anchor and how can it be used during fertility medical procedures?
2f4dadbcb9.a: A relaxation anchor is simply a gesture or cue that your body makes that associates you with a calmer, grounded state—it might be placing a hand over your heart or gently touching your fingertips together. During a session, you practice pairing this cue with relaxation and supportive suggestions. Over time, this gesture can become a reminder to pause, relax, and remember those supportive suggestions. You can use your anchor while sitting in a waiting room, preparing for a procedure, or moving through a stressful day.

a425d5aad0.q: How does acuhypnosis help work through negative thought patterns related to fertility?
a425d5aad0.a: Fertility can bring up deeply personal beliefs and painful thoughts like 'my body is failing me,' 'maybe I'm not doing enough,' or 'what if this never happens for me?' Hypnosis can break this chain of repetitiveness and provide a setting where you can explore more compassionate, loving responses to those beliefs. Through the practice, you might replace 'my body is failing me' with 'my body is going through a lot and I deserve care' or develop the ability to feel hopeful and afraid at the same time.
